source_units.text: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw.
source_units.display_text: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw.

source_units.text: Are these things not from the Lord Almighty? Many peoples failed in fire, and many nations lost heart.
source_units.display_text: Are these things not from the Lord Almighty? Many peoples failed in fire, and many nations lost heart.

source_units.text: O you who make your neighbor drink with a turbid overthrow and intoxicate him, so that you may look upon their caves!
source_units.display_text: O you who make your neighbor drink with a turbid overthrow and intoxicate him, so that you may look upon their caves!

source_units.text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, with a song.
source_units.display_text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, with a song.

source_units.text: A word will go before Him, and He will go out, His feet in sandals.
source_units.display_text: A word will go before Him, and He will go out, His feet in sandals.

source_units.text: Thou didst cut the heads of rulers in bewilderment; they will be shaken in it. They will open their bridles like a poor person eating secretly.
source_units.display_text: Thou didst cut the heads of rulers in bewilderment; they will be shaken in it. They will open their bridles like a poor person eating secretly.
